projectName.description: The project's display name, which is also its folder name. The adapter refuses a name containing a path separator rather than silently mangling it into nested folders.

projectLocation.description: Optional folder to create it in, relative to the projects root. The adapter joins the name onto it and re-checks that the result stays inside that root.

projectSummary.description: Optional one-line summary, written into the PROJECT.md descriptor.

projectImportance.description: Ordering weight for the Projects widget (higher first). Absent uses the shipped template's default.
